title: My answer to the housing crisis
author: Oli4K
selftext:
!\[img\](w7j29dndiswh1)

I needed a house for a project in Godot, but I'm too lazy to open Blender and build some so I asked Codex to create a plugin. It is not perfect yet but it works and generates a few different styles of houses. I spent some time tweaking the logic so windows don't protrude through roofs, added some color variation and lots of other small details. So far it can generate sheds, chalets, town houses, farm houses, cottages, flats/condo's, villa's, churches and shops with seeded configurations so the variations are practically endless.

Version 0.1.0 \[is published\](https://github.com/Oli4k/building-generator), 99.9% vibecoded and completely free. Praise, ideas and constructive feedback are welcome.

The whole project costed me a few hours of prompting and testing, that I did while working on a few other projects at the same time while waiting for code to be generated.

Some ideas to add in future versions:

\* Land plots with garden, path towards the door, white picket fence  
\* Improved control over layout, floor plan dimensions  
\* Automated stacking/joining to other houses, alignment to roads  
\* More building types (glass office tower, depressing concrete flat, classic villa, suburban house, trailer, timber framed house, warehouse, hangar, garage, etc)  
\* Further tweak seed variation and general layout of details

P.S. Besides all kinds of architectural jargon I picked up while working on this project, I learned that churches typically have their tower on the West. Who said AI makes you dumber?
